chart_review.windows: 126 market sessions before and after each signal

compressed_five_rules: The stock lost at least 10 percent over the preceding 20 completed sessions.
The completed signal session opened at least 1 percent below the preceding close and made a new five-session low.
Signal-session turnover was at least the preceding 20-session mean.
The signal session closed at or above the preceding high and in the upper 30 percent of its own range.
At least one other independent stock produced the same frozen mother signal on that completed session.

frozen_candidate_sets.definition: Exact frozen mother signal; no chart-derived filter.
Exact frozen mother signal AND same completed-session frozen mother-signal count >= 2.
frozen_candidate_sets.economic_meaning: Cross-sectional confirmation that forced selling was market-wide rather than purely idiosyncratic.

explicitly_rejected_chart_rules: No maximum gap-down cutoff: large-gap winners were common.
No signal-low stop: many target winners breached the signal low first.
No mandatory next-session rise: profitable paths often retested or delayed.
No 60-session trend-sign filter: winners and losers occupied both signs.
No five-session structural-reclaim requirement: only 35 of 625 development signals qualified, too sparse for the declared opportunity goal.
execution: Unchanged frozen T10_H20_NO_STOP source translation with 40 bps round-trip cost.
